task:
You are a clinic staff member using Medplum, the clinic's electronic health record, in a web browser. The screen is 1280x800 pixels and you are already signed in. Medplum stores its records on a FHIR R4 server; this web app is how you read and change them. Use only this app, and change nothing the task doesn't ask for.

When you have finished, or if you can't finish, stop acting and end your reply with one final line in exactly one of these two forms:
RESULT: DONE <the record's id, such as Patient/0193..., or the URL of its page>
RESULT: NOT DONE <the reason, in one line>
Write RESULT: DONE only if the record now exists exactly as the task asks (created by you, or already there).

The task:
Make sure this appointment is booked, exactly once, as an Appointment. If it is already booked, don't book another: report the existing record.
Patient: Tomasz Wren (born 1966-01-30). Find their Patient record first.
Practitioner: Dr Ama Osei (a Practitioner on the server).
Start: 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z
End: 2026-11-17T14:30:00Z
Status booked, with two participants (the patient and the practitioner), each with status accepted.

items.criterion: Use the Medplum EHR web app
items.description: Attempt the task within the Medplum web application as specified. Full credit if: (a) actions are clearly taken in Medplum, OR (b) the app is inaccessible (errors/login/MFA/CAPTCHA issues) and this is clearly reported. Partial credit if the agent proceeds elsewhere without first attempting Medplum. No credit if the agent ignores the specified platform despite it being available.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient record (Tomasz Wren, DOB 1966-01-30)
items.description: Find and confirm the exact Patient resource for Tomasz Wren with the matching date of birth. Full credit if the correct record is identified; OR if no such patient exists after a reasonable search (e.g., by name and DOB) and this is clearly reported; OR if Medplum is inaccessible and this is clearly reported after an attempt to access it. Partial credit if a likely match is found but DOB is not verified or ambiguity is noted without resolution.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Practitioner record (Dr Ama Osei)
items.description: Find and confirm the Practitioner resource for Dr Ama Osei. Full credit if the correct practitioner is identified; OR if no such practitioner exists after a reasonable search and this is clearly reported; OR if Medplum is inaccessible and this is clearly reported after an attempt to access it. Partial credit if multiple matches exist and the agent proceeds reasonably but does not fully disambiguate.

items.criterion: Check for an existing Appointment to avoid duplicates
items.description: Search for an existing Appointment matching: Patient Tomasz Wren, Practitioner Dr Ama Osei, Start 2026-11-17T14:00:00Z, End 2026-11-17T14:30:00Z. Full credit if a reasonable, explicit search is performed by date/time and participants (or as close as Medplum's filters allow) and findings are stated; OR if the agent clearly reports that the check cannot be completed due to platform limitations (e.g., Medplum unavailable, search filters not supporting participants) or because the required Patient/Practitioner records do not exist after reasonable search. Partial credit if the search is superficial but there is an evident attempt to avoid duplicates.

items.criterion: Report existing Appointment without creating a duplicate
items.condition: Only applies if an Appointment with the exact specified details already exists
items.description: Full credit if the agent does not create another Appointment and instead reports the existing record (including its id or page URL) as the single source of truth. Partial credit if the agent identifies an existing record but still creates another or fails to provide the id/URL. No credit if a duplicate is created when an exact match already exists.

items.criterion: Create the Appointment exactly as specified
items.condition: Only applies if no matching Appointment already exists
items.description: Create and save a single FHIR Appointment resource with: status=booked; start=2026-11-17T14:00:00Z; end=2026-11-17T14:30:00Z; exactly two participants: (1) Patient Tomasz Wren with participant.status=accepted and (2) Practitioner Dr Ama Osei with participant.status=accepted; no extras. Full credit if all fields match and exactly one Appointment is created. Full credit also if creation is not possible due to external constraints (e.g., Medplum unavailable, insufficient permissions, validator errors, or missing Patient/Practitioner after reasonable search) and this limitation is clearly reported after an attempt to create. Partial credit for minor omissions (e.g., correct time and participants but one participant status not set to accepted) if corrected prior to final save, or for preparing the correct resource but being blocked at save while clearly reporting the issue. No credit if key attributes are wrong, multiple appointments are created, or the agent stops short of saving without any external blocking reason.

items.criterion: Provide final RESULT line with the correct record reference
items.description: End the reply with exactly one of: 'RESULT: DONE <Appointment/<id> or page URL>' if the appointment exists exactly once with all required details; OR 'RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason>' if blocked (e.g., missing Patient/Practitioner, platform issues). Full credit if format and content are correct and consistent with the actual outcome. Partial credit if minor formatting errors occur but the id/URL and outcome are still clear.
